# ATM Isı Transfer

> ATM Isı Transfer: since 1986, parts and machines for the white goods and air conditioning industry; wire-on-tube condensers, formed tubes, heat exchangers.

Legal name: ATM Isı Transfer Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Şirketi (ATM Isı Transfer Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş., MERSİS 0103144809100001).
Headquarters: İnönü Mah. Gebze Güzeller OSB Mah. Nursultan Nazarbayev Sk. No: 17, Gebze, Kocaeli, Türkiye.
Factories: Gebze (Head Office) Factory (Gebze Güzeller Organize Sanayi Bölgesi Nursultan Nazarbayev Sok. No:17, 41400 Kocaeli/Türkiye, +90 262 751 47 61); Manisa Factory (Muradiye Organize Sanayi Bölgesi Mah. Eski Menemen Cad. No:11, 45140 Manisa/Türkiye, +90 236 213 02 72).
Contact: atm@atm-tr.com, sales: sales@atm-tr.com, WhatsApp: +90 530 513 96 87, WeChat: ATM-Sales, careers: ik@atm-tr.com.
Languages: Türkçe at /atm-tr-t/, English at /atm-tr-t/en/, Deutsch at /atm-tr-t/de/.

## Products
- [Products](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/en/products/): ATM products: wire-on-tube condensers for commercial refrigeration, formed tubes for appliances and HVAC, and OEM and finned heat exchangers. Gebze and Manisa.
- [Wire-on-Tube Condensers](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/en/wire-on-tube-condensers/): ATM wire-on-tube condensers: static, dynamic and Low Maintenance ATM condensers made on our own machines since 1986, for commercial cabinets and cooling units.
- [Static Condensers](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/en/wire-on-tube-condensers/static-condensers/): 4–8 mm steel tube, cataphoresis or powder coated, in custom dimensions for bottle coolers, display cabinets and refrigerators.
- [Dynamic Wire-on-Tube Condensers](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/en/wire-on-tube-condensers/dynamic-condensers/): Fan-cooled, single-row tube, polyethylene coated; custom designed for supermarket cabinets, displays and beverage coolers.
- [ATM Condensers](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/en/wire-on-tube-condensers/low-maintenance-atm-condensers-patented/): A patented replacement for fin coils: it does not clog and needs no periodic cleaning.
- [Formed Tubes](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/en/tube-forming/): ATM tube forming: 2–35 mm copper, aluminum and stainless steel tubes, formed on our own automatic machines at our Manisa plant, with 100% gauge and leak tests.
- [Appliance Tubes](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/en/tube-forming/appliance-tubes/): 2–32 mm copper, aluminium and stainless steel connection tubes for refrigerators, washing machines, dishwashers, freezers and split air conditioners.
- [Tube Solutions for HVAC Units](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/en/tube-forming/hvac-tubes/): 4–32 mm copper and stainless steel tubes in custom forms for air handling units, fan coils, chillers and VRF, 100% dimension and leak tested.
- [OEM and Finned Heat Exchangers](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/en/products/oem-heat-exchangers/): Aluminium or copper fins, designed for your system: air handling units, cold rooms, fan coils and industrial cabinets.
- [Software](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/en/softwares/): ATM's software: programs developed for using its wire-on-tube and finned condensers and heat exchangers, so cabinet makers can pick an equivalent ATM condenser.

## Competencies
- [Competencies](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/en/competencies/): ATM's competencies: machine manufacturing, jig and fixture manufacturing, R&D organization, digital transformation and quality system, each in its own section.
- [Machine Manufacturing](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/en/competencies/#machine-manufacturing): We design and build most of the machines we use in production ourselves.
- [Jig and Fixture Manufacturing](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/en/competencies/#jig-and-fixture-manufacturing): We make our own control and final shaping jigs for tube forming.
- [R&D Organization](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/en/competencies/#rd-organization): A ministry-registered Design Center, 25 engineers and 12 technicians, 18 industrial property rights.
- [Digital Transformation](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/en/competencies/#digital-transformation): Machine control software, automation and in-plant data communication from our own team.
- [Quality System](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/en/competencies/#quality-system): A quality management system to ISO 9001:2015.

- [Telli Kondanserler](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/telli-kondanserler/): ATM telli kondenserler: 1986’dan bu yana makinelerimizle üretilen statik, dinamik ve Düşük Bakımlı ATM kondenserler, ticari dolaplar ve soğutma üniteleri için.
- [Statik Kondanserler](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/telli-kondanserler/statik-kondanserler/): 4–8 mm çelik borulu, kataforez ya da toz boya kaplı; şişe soğutucuları, vitrinler ve buzdolapları için müşteriye özel ölçüde.
- [Dinamik Telli Kondanserler](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/telli-kondanserler/dinamik-telli-kondanserler/): Fanlı, tek sıra borulu, polietilen kaplı; süpermarket dolapları, teşhir üniteleri ve içecek dolapları için özel tasarım.
- [ATM Kondanserler](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/telli-kondanserler/atm-kondanserler/): Lamelli bataryaların yerine patentli tasarım: tıkanmaz, periyodik temizlik gerektirmez.
- [Şekillendirilmiş Borular](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/sekillendirilmis-borular/): ATM boru şekillendirme: 2–35 mm bakır, alüminyum ve paslanmaz çelik borular; kendi otomatik makinelerimizle, Manisa fabrikamızda, %100 mastar ve kaçak testiyle.
- [Beyaz Eşya Boruları](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/sekillendirilmis-borular/beyaz-esya-borulari/): Buzdolabı, çamaşır ve bulaşık makinesi, dondurucu ve split klimalar için 2–32 mm bakır, alüminyum ve paslanmaz bağlantı boruları.
- [İklimlendirme Üniteleri İçin Boru Çözümleri](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/sekillendirilmis-borular/iklimlendirme-uniteleri-icin-boru-cozumleri/): Klima santrali, fancoil, chiller ve VRF için 4–32 mm bakır ve paslanmaz borular; %100 ölçü kontrolü ve kaçak testi.
- [OEM ve Finli Isı Eşanjörleri](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/urunler/oem-ve-finli-isi-esanjorleri/): Klima santralleri, soğuk odalar, fancoiller ve endüstriyel dolaplar için alüminyum ya da bakır finli, sisteminize özel.
- [Yazılımlar](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/yazilimlar/): ATM yazılımları: Telli ve Yapraklı Kondanserler ile Eşanjörlerin kullanımı için geliştirilen programlar; dolap üreticileri muadil ATM kondanserini seçebilir.
- [Yetkinlikler](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/yetkinlikler/): ATM'nin yetkinlikleri: makine imalatı, jig ve fikstür imalatı, Ar-Ge organizasyonu, dijital dönüşüm ve kalite sistemi; her biri sayfada ayrı bir bölümde.
- [Yetkinlikler: Makine İmalatı](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/yetkinlikler/#makine-imalati): Üretimde kullandığımız makinelerin çoğunu kendimiz tasarlayıp üretiyoruz.
- [Yetkinlikler: Jig ve Fikstür İmalatı](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/yetkinlikler/#jig-ve-fikstur-imalati): Boru şekillendirmenin kontrol ve son şekillendirme jiglerini kendimiz yapıyoruz.
- [Yetkinlikler: ArGe Organizasyonu](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/yetkinlikler/#arge-organizasyonu): Bakanlık tescilli Tasarım Merkezi, 25 mühendis ve 12 tekniker, 18 Sınai Mülkiyet Hakkı.
- [Yetkinlikler: Dijital Dönüşüm](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/yetkinlikler/#dijital-donusum): Makine kontrol yazılımları, otomasyon ve fabrika içi veri iletişimi kendi ekibimizden.
- [Yetkinlikler: Kalite Sistemi](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/yetkinlikler/#kalite-sistemi): ISO 9001:2015 standardına uygun kalite yönetim sistemi.

- [Produkte](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/de/produkte/): ATM-Produkte: Drahtrohrverflüssiger für die gewerbliche Kühlung, geformte Rohre für Haushaltsgeräte und Klimatechnik sowie OEM- und Lamellenwärmetauscher.
- [Drahtrohrverflüssiger](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/de/drahtrohrverfluessiger/): ATM-Drahtrohrverflüssiger, seit 1986 auf eigenen Maschinen gefertigt: statische, dynamische und wartungsarme ATM-Verflüssiger für Kühlmöbel und Kälteeinheiten.
- [Statische Verflüssiger](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/de/drahtrohrverfluessiger/statische-verfluessiger/): Stahlrohre 4–8 mm, KTL- oder pulverbeschichtet, in Maßen nach Kundenwunsch für Flaschenkühler, Vitrinen und Kühlschränke.
- [Dynamische Drahtrohrverflüssiger](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/de/drahtrohrverfluessiger/dynamische-verfluessiger/): Ventilatorbelüftet, einreihig, polyethylenbeschichtet; individuell für Supermarktkühlmöbel, Vitrinen und Getränkekühler.
- [ATM-Verflüssiger](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/de/drahtrohrverfluessiger/wartungsarme-atm-verfluessiger/): Patentierter Ersatz für Lamellenregister: verstopft nicht, keine regelmäßige Reinigung.
- [Geformte Rohre](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/de/rohrformung/): ATM-Rohrformung: Kupfer-, Aluminium- und Edelstahlrohre von 2–35 mm, auf eigenen Automaten im Werk Manisa gefertigt, mit 100 % Lehren- und Dichtheitsprüfung.
- [Rohre für Haushaltsgeräte](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/de/rohrformung/rohre-fuer-haushaltsgeraete/): Rohre aus Kupfer, Aluminium und Edelstahl (2–32 mm) für Kühlschränke, Wasch- und Geschirrspüler, Tiefkühlgeräte und Split-Klimageräte.
- [Rohrlösungen für Klimageräte](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/de/rohrformung/rohre-fuer-klimageraete/): Kupfer- und Edelstahlrohre von 4–32 mm in Formen nach Maß für RLT-Geräte, Fancoils, Kaltwassersätze und VRF, mit 100 % Maß- und Dichtheitsprüfung.
- [OEM- und Lamellenwärmetauscher](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/de/produkte/oem-waermetauscher/): Aluminium- oder Kupferlamellen, auf Ihr System ausgelegt: RLT-Geräte, Kühlräume, Fancoils und Industrieschränke.
- [Software](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/de/software/): ATM-Software: Programme für den Einsatz der Draht- und Lamellenverflüssiger und Wärmetauscher von ATM; Hersteller finden damit gleichwertige ATM-Verflüssiger.
- [Kompetenzen](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/de/kompetenzen/): Die Kompetenzen von ATM: Maschinenbau, Vorrichtungsbau, F&E-Organisation, digitale Transformation und Qualitätssystem, je in einem eigenen Abschnitt der Seite.
- [Kompetenzen: Maschinenbau](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/de/kompetenzen/#maschinenbau): Die meisten Maschinen unserer Produktion konstruieren und bauen wir selbst.
- [Kompetenzen: Vorrichtungsbau](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/de/kompetenzen/#vorrichtungsbau): Prüf- und Endformvorrichtungen für die Rohrformung fertigen wir selbst.
- [Kompetenzen: F&E-Organisation](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/de/kompetenzen/#fe-organisation): Ein vom Ministerium registriertes Designzentrum, 25 Ingenieure und 12 Techniker, 18 Schutzrechte.
- [Kompetenzen: Digitale Transformation](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/de/kompetenzen/#digitale-transformation): Maschinensteuerungen, Automatisierung und werksinterne Datenkommunikation aus dem eigenen Team.
- [Kompetenzen: Qualitätssystem](https://atm-tr.com/atm-tr-t/de/kompetenzen/#qualitaetssystem): Ein Qualitätsmanagementsystem nach ISO 9001:2015.
